hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly deduced that the father of the 1st Earl is the 2nd Earl's paternal grandfather. The 1st Earl IS the paternal grandfather; the father of the 1st Earl is the GREAT-grandfather. The Planner failed to count the generational gap correctly or misunderstood the genealogical relationship presented in the WebSurfer output.
